# Elemental Sandbox vendored effects

Source: https://github.com/achrefelouafi/LinearAbiltyCastingThreeJS
Commit: 97f1de19617e9a2e3af3c8021c8c21c8f58b40f3
License: MIT (LICENSE). Three.js 0.185.1: three/LICENSE.

Only the six procedural abilities, their dependencies and postprocessing are included.
Imports are rewritten to local relative URLs. No upstream character, textures, UI or network services are included.
The planner hosts the effects in a separate document, keeping Three.js 0.185.1 and its global settings isolated from the game's Three.js 0.169.
